installation.choose: If you know which namespace holds the real Argo CD, choose it: Sextant remembers the choice for this cluster and signs in only there. Anyone who can write in a namespace can make it look like Argo CD.
installation.several: Several namespaces of this cluster have an argocd-server Service ({{namespaces}}), so the extension connects to none of them by itself.

login.errors.invalid: Argo CD refused the user name or password.
login.errors.invalidToken: Argo CD refused the API token: it is wrong, expired or revoked.
login.errors.other: Signing in to Argo CD did not work.
login.errors.unreachable: Argo CD is not reachable: its server has no ready pod or does not answer.
login.expired: The Argo CD session has expired and signing in again with the saved login did not work.
login.hint: Before asking, the extension tries the login saved for this cluster, the admin password from argocd-initial-admin-secret and API tokens in Secrets labelled app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argocd. Sextant puts them into the sign-in itself and asks for a login in its own dialog, so the extension never sees a password or token. argocd-secret holds only a bcrypt hash of the admin password, so it cannot be used to sign in.
login.insecure: This Argo CD runs its server without TLS (server.insecure in argocd-cmd-params-cm), so Sextant talks to it in plain HTTP: inside the cluster, the password or token travels unencrypted.
login.intro: Sextant could not sign in to Argo CD in {{namespace}} by itself. Sign in with a local user or an API token.
login.mode.label: How to sign in
login.noLocalUsers: This Argo CD has no local users who may sign in with a password: use an API token.
login.refused.adminSecret: Argo CD refused the admin password from argocd-initial-admin-secret: it may have been changed in Argo CD. Enter the current password.
login.refused.saved: Argo CD refused the saved login: its password or token may have changed. Sign in with the current one (with Remember to replace the saved login).
login.refused.tokenSecret: Argo CD refused the API token from a Secret labelled app.kubernetes.io/part-of=argocd: it may be expired or revoked.
login.sso: Sign-in through SSO is not supported in Sextant.
